lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows, with spatial frequency decreasing from the branchial region toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated shapes (remoras) attached to the lower lateral flank and near the base of the pectoral fin.
